Answered 24/7

Electrical emergency?

Don’t wait on these. They turn into fire hazards quickly. If there’s smoke or fire, call 911 first.

Call (832) 610-8081 What to do while you wait

Call now if you have

  • Sparks or arcing from an outlet, switch or panel
  • A burning or hot-plastic smell
  • An outlet, switch or panel that is hot to the touch
  • Power out to part of the house while the neighbors have power
  • A breaker that trips again every time it’s reset
  • Storm or tree damage to the wiring on your house

What happens after you get in touch

  1. We confirm

    We check we cover the work and your address, and come back to you on timing.

  2. A technician visits

    They look at the job in person, including anything underneath it you may not have spotted.

  3. You get the price in writing

    A written estimate, on the spot, with no obligation to go ahead.

  4. The work gets done

    To code, on the agreed day, with permits where needed and our guarantee behind it.
